mentions.name: OpenRun
mentions.description: OpenRun makes it easy for teams to securely deploy internal tools and webapps. It runs as a proxy that adds SAML/OAuth-based authentication with RBAC, and deploys containerized apps either to a single machine with Docker or onto Kubernetes. It is adding support for exposing Postgres schemas per app, so each app can get a dedicated schema or limited/full access to another app's schema with row level security rules.
mentions.problem: While creating new apps has gotten easier, securely deploying them across teams remains a challenge.
mentions.audience: Teams deploying internal tools and webapps

mentions.name: OpenRun
mentions.description: A platform for declarative deployment of web apps. Runs as a web server performing GitOps-driven app deployments, currently supporting deployment on standalone machines via Docker/Podman, with Kubernetes support in progress. On Kubernetes it would replace build jobs (Jenkins/Actions), CD (ArgoCD) and IDPs (Backstage), using the same declarative config across environments with no YAML to maintain.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building https://github.com/openrundev/openrun, a platform for declarative deployment of web apps.

OpenRun runs as a web server, which does GitOps driven app deployments. You can currently deploy apps on a standalone machine, on top of Docker/Podman.
